note: Article titles. Scope notes are our own paraphrase. Most listed articles apply to high-risk AI systems.

items.title: AI literacy
items.summary: Providers and deployers ensure staff have enough AI literacy.

items.title: Risk management system
items.summary: Run a risk management system across the high-risk AI life cycle.

items.title: Data and data governance
items.summary: Training, validation and test data meet quality and governance criteria.

items.title: Technical documentation
items.summary: Draw up technical documentation before the system is placed on the market.

items.title: Record-keeping
items.summary: High-risk systems allow automatic recording of events (logs).

items.title: Transparency and provision of information to deployers
items.summary: Systems come with instructions for use and are transparent to deployers.

items.title: Human oversight
items.summary: Design systems so humans can oversee them effectively.

items.title: Accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity
items.summary: Systems reach appropriate accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity.

items.title: Quality management system
items.summary: Providers put a documented quality management system in place.

items.title: Automatically generated logs
items.summary: Providers keep logs generated by their high-risk systems.

items.title: Responsibilities along the AI value chain
items.summary: Allocates obligations between providers, distributors, deployers and third parties.

items.title: Obligations of deployers of high-risk AI systems
items.summary: Deployers use systems per instructions, assign human oversight and monitor operation.

items.title: Fundamental rights impact assessment for high-risk AI systems
items.summary: Certain deployers assess impact on fundamental rights before use.

items.title: Transparency obligations for providers and deployers of certain AI systems
items.summary: People are told when they interact with AI or see AI-generated content.

items.title: Post-market monitoring by providers and post-market monitoring plan for high-risk AI systems
items.summary: Providers monitor performance after the system is on the market.

items.title: Reporting of serious incidents
items.summary: Providers report serious incidents to market surveillance authorities.
